newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Seoul central bank sells dlrs again to support won.
newsitem.headline: Seoul central bank sells dlrs again to support won.

text.p: The Bank of Korea intervened again in the interbank market in the mid-morning session on Monday to slow the U.S. dollar's rise against the won, dealers said.
The bank sold dollars at between 863.00 and 865.00 won per U.S. dollar, after an earlier intervention was seen at 863.00 won, they said.
The central bank refused to comment on talk of its intervention.
The won was trading at 864.00 just after the intervention. It opened the day's trading at 857.70 and touched an intraday low of 865.00.
On Friday, the won closed trading at 857.70.
